Kutuphane -> Calgi sayfasi -> Kurs -> Ders. Her calgi KENDI sayfasi.
DURUSTLUK KURALLARI (mekanik olarak test edilir, tools/validate_library.py):
1. status=coming_soon olan calgida KURS OLAMAZ (sahte kurs listelenmez).
2. Her kursun en az 1 dersi olmak zorunda (bos kurs listelenmez).
3. Ders, ruleset'te BULUNMAYAN teknige atif yapamaz.
4. Her calgida honesty bloku ZORUNLU (neler olculur / neler OLCULMEZ).
5. status=locked olan her ders lockedReason tasimak zorunda (esik degeri DEGIL, EKSIK OLCUMUN adi).
6. Kapsam-disi (comingSoonInThisDiscipline) her madde gerekce tasimak zorunda.

disciplines.blurb: Put your phone where it can see you sitting with your guitar. We check your sitting posture against how real teachers sit, and listen for the chords you play.

measured: Trunk alignment while sitting (checked against 3 independent guitar teachers, M-O-47/48)
Chord class for 8 open chords — E A D G C Am Em Dm (kromagram/template matching, M-O-35)
notMeasured: Arm and hand position while holding the guitar — teachers disagree about this by style (11-18 degrees apart), we show it but do not grade it (M-O-46)
Finger placement or fretting technique — camera cannot see fingers well enough to grade them yet
Strum timing quality judgement — measured, not yet graded (expertPending)
Full note-by-note transcription — we recognise the chord class, not every note played

courses.goal: Set up your space, sit correctly, and learn to hear when you're playing the right open chord.

trunk_tilt referansi ATTESTED (3 bagimsiz egitmen, M-O-47) ve tuketicisi CANLI oldugu kanitlandi (M-O-48) — bu ders yalniz o olcumu kullanir, chord_correctness'a bagli DEGIL.

Ders yine de ACIK ve postur SKORLANIYOR: skorlama ATTESTED referansa ve scoringBarDeg=22'ye dayaniyor (M-O-47/48), dogrulanmamis bir hata esigine degil. Fark: olctugumuz seyi soyluyoruz, hak etmedigimiz hukmu reklam etmiyoruz.

Ikisi de gercek; akor TANIMASI GEREKMIYOR — ne calindigi degil, calarken durusun bozulup bozulmadigi sorusu. Uctan-uca senaryoda bu zincir zaten kosuldu (M-O-52: POSTURE_CHECK 116/116 -> PLAY 115/115).

lessons.lockedReason: We can see your arms but we deliberately do not grade them. The three teachers we measured hold the guitar 11-18 degrees apart from each other — that is style, not error, so there is no honest 'correct' to score you against. This lesson opens only if a measurement is found that separates style from mistake.

Nothing below your hips is measured. Our posture reference is built from upper-body landmarks only, because guitar teaching footage is filmed waist-up — knees and ankles are usually not in frame at all. Without leg landmarks we cannot tell a footstool from a crossed leg.

Chord recognition has only been proven on synthetic audio (8/8 chords, zero false judgements) — it hasn't been tested on a real guitar recording yet. We won't grade you against a measurement we haven't confirmed on a real instrument.

comingSoonInThisDiscipline: Strum timing as a graded skill — measured but not yet gated (expertPending, quality bar unset)
Arm/hand posture as a graded skill — teachers disagree by style, this may never become gradeable (see honesty box)

disciplines.blurb: Sing along and get feedback on pitch, sustain and posture.
disciplines.comingSoonReason: Posture reference needs 3 independent teachers agreeing. The pool grew to 9 eligible sources with 3-4 usable hold-windows, so 'not enough footage' is no longer the reason — the takes disagree (deviations 42.0 / 33.0 / 20.5 / 37.7 degrees, no cluster). Singers also move structurally more than seated players, and a second window-finder built for sustained poses could read only 3 of 9 sources. We will not grade your singing posture against a reference we could not build honestly.

notMeasured: Everything — nothing is live yet. Pitch and periodicity motors exist (ostinato_audio, engine status) but no posture reference has passed the agreement gate.

disciplines.blurb: Practice five-finger patterns and chords with posture and hand feedback.
disciplines.comingSoonReason: Posture reference needs 3 independent teachers agreeing. The pool is no longer the problem: after re-classification it holds 8 eligible sources and 3 hold-windows — enough takes. They simply do NOT agree (deviations 16.2 / 46.4 / 27.3 degrees; no cluster even at a relaxed bar). Two rescue routes were measured and both failed: harvesting with new search terms (7 fresh candidates, 0 new windows) and a second window-finder built for sustained-pose clips (readable in only 2 of 8 piano sources, fewer than the tool we already use). We will not grade your piano posture against teachers who disagree with each other.

notMeasured: Everything — nothing is live yet. Pitch and periodicity motors exist and are tested, but no posture reference has passed the agreement gate.
Why it is stuck is now measured, not guessed: enough usable takes exist, they disagree with each other. More footage does not fix disagreement.
